# Borthwick Decorators

> > Award-winning painting and decorating company serving Edinburgh and Central Scotland since 1959, specializing in residential, commercial, and heritage restoration projects.

Borthwick Decorators Ltd is a family-run business with over 60 years of experience, accredited by the Scottish Decorators Federation, Painting and Decorating Association, and multiple safety organizations including CHAS, SMAS, and SafeContractor. They offer comprehensive interior and exterior painting, spray painting, wallpaper hanging, and hand-painted kitchen services across Edinburgh, Glasgow, East Lothian, Stirling, and surrounding areas.

## Key Topics

- Scottish Decorators Federation

- Colour psychology and selection
- PASMA and IPAF certified
